answer: Every identity posts a compute heartbeat: proof of work stamped by a random beacon. Each epoch the beacon flags a violet audit slot at random; any identity missing its heartbeat loses the shared haven of rewards. A Sybil farmer faces a canyon of cost: 1,000 fake identities must each run a heartbeat, about 40 POA of compute per identity per epoch, so 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 POA; one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps its full share.
